hub.name: FYAISA
hub.tagline: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.
hub.description: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.

apps.name: FYAISA
apps.summary: The FYAISA hub app itself. Update it from here.
apps.description: The FYAISA homebrew hub for Vega OS Fire TV devices. Browse, install and update homebrew apps from your couch. This is the hub app itself, listed so you can update it from within.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: ./scripts/install-hub.sh, or from installer/: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: The FYAISA hub app itself. Update it from here.
Opens with a short wordmark intro: the letters spread out and spell out what the acronym means. Any remote press skips it.
ElevSH gets a Discover button: with `fyaisa connect --lan` running, the hub finds your computer through a reverse tunnel — no IP to type on the D-pad.
Power Tools gains a de-bloater: tick preinstalled apps you never use — a preset covers the usual suspects — and remove them over ElevSH.
App details gain Open on Fire TV and Uninstall buttons: launch a homebrew app, or remove it with a two-tap confirm — no terminal needed.
The address box still opens pre-filled with 192.168. as a manual fallback; pasted addresses and hostnames are normalised.
2.0.0: 13 themes including Cyberpunk, Matrix and High Contrast; animated backgrounds, focus pulse and press feedback; screenshot previews when entries publish them; in-hub hub update notices.
2.0.0: `fyaisa connect --lan` no longer needs the Vega CLI in PATH, opens the firewall port, and prints the exact address to pair from.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Couch Scoreboard
apps.summary: Two-team scorekeeper for board games and couch tournaments. Fully offline.
apps.description: Couch Scoreboard is a pure React Native scorekeeper for Vega OS Fire TV devices. Pick a team with the D-pad, add or remove points with the remote, and set an optional winning target. No WebView, no network, no sign-in.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.fyaisa.scoreboard.main, or from apps/scoreboard: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Pure React Native — no WebView, no network, works fully offline.
D-pad up/down picks a team, left/right adjusts the score, OK adds a point, Menu resets, Play/Pause cycles the winning target.
Large score display designed for ten-foot viewing.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.summary: The sliding-tile puzzle, fully offline and driven by the D-pad.
apps.description: 2048 is a fully offline sliding-tile puzzle for Vega OS Fire TV devices. D-pad slides tiles, OK starts a new game, Menu undoes the last move, and Back quits. All board rendering and tile art are local; nothing is downloaded after install.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.fyaisa.g2048.main, or from apps/g2048: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Pure React Native — no WebView, no network, works fully offline.
D-pad slides, OK starts a new game, Menu undoes the last move (20-step history).
Local board and scoring; no account and no downloaded assets.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: TV Timer
apps.summary: Stopwatch and countdown timer for your Fire TV. Works fully offline, driven by the remote.
apps.description: TV Timer is a stopwatch and a countdown timer in one app for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Pure React Native UI — no WebView, no network, nothing to sign in to. The remote drives it: D-pad switches mode and adjusts minutes, OK starts and stops, Menu resets, Back quits. Great for cooking timers, workout rests, or anything you want to time from the couch.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.tvtimer.main, or from apps/tvtimer: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Pure React Native — no WebView, no network, works fully offline.
D-pad switches mode and adjusts minutes, OK starts/stops, Menu resets, Back quits.
1.0.1: timer state and remote input handling fixed.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Super Mario Bros
apps.summary: NES SMB emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks (no ROM bundled). Downloads ROM from external source on first launch.
apps.description: Super Mario Bros NES emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Runs in a WebView using jsnes. Downloads the Super Mario Bros ROM from an external source on first launch so no copyrighted ROM is bundled (legally clean). TV remote mapping: D-Pad, Menu=Start, Back=Select, Fast-forward=A, Play/Pause=B. No WebView browsing, d-pad navigable.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.smb.main, or from apps/smb: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Super Mario Bros NES emulator (jsnes). Downloads the ROM from an external host on first launch (no ROM bundled).
1.0.1: invalid manifest service removed and catalog note corrected.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Cinevega
apps.summary: Movies and TV streaming with a native TV interface. TMDB metadata, VidSrc playback.
apps.description: Cinevega is a native React Native streaming app for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Browse trending, popular movies and TV shows with full TMDB metadata (posters, overviews, ratings), search, and play through VidSrc. No WebView browsing, no captchas, no sign-up. D-pad navigable interface designed for the couch.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.cinevega.main, or from apps/cinevega: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Native React Native frontend with TMDB metadata and VidSrc playback.
Fixed: declares com.amazon.network.service so TMDB and VidSrc can be reached.
Fixed: VidSrc mirror fallbacks (vidsrc.to, .cc, .xyz, .pro, .net) — if one domain dies, the app tries the next.
1.0.2: mirror failover hardened and lockfile aligned.
1.0.3: D-pad cursor in the player, OK clicks the page instead of exiting, chrome auto-hides on playback, ElevSH host prefilled with 192.168.
1.0.4: cursor is now a visible native overlay (on by default) driven by the D-pad; OK clicks exactly where the pointer is.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: VegaTube
apps.summary: Ad-free, sponsor-free YouTube for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks.
apps.description: Runs the official YouTube for TVs web app (youtube.com/tv) in a Vega WebView and injects the TizenTube userscript at document start, giving ad blocking, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, speed controls and themes on devices that cannot run the Android APK. Formerly TizenTube Vega; VegaTube is the reference app for the hub's WebView injection technique (it ships without the ElevSH pairing client — ElevSH Files has that).
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.vegatube.main, or from apps/vegatube: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Contains a vendored copy of the TizenTube userscript (GPL-3.0); upstream credits live in the repos.
Updates install on the TV via `fyaisa update app.vegatube.main` (no in-app pairing); the ElevSH client lives in ElevSH Files.
1.3.1: invalid manifest services removed and install script aligned with the Vega SDK.

1.3.2: native Menu control strip (play/pause, ±10s, speed, next, settings) that works without TizenTube's transport patch; injection retries dropped chunks; hidden preview videos paused and OS media control disabled to cut stutter; invalid Vega 1.2 module dependency removed.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: ElevSH Files
apps.summary: Browse your Fire TV's real filesystem with the D-pad, over ElevSH.
apps.description: The app itself is sandboxed, so it reaches the real device filesystem indirectly: every directory listing and file preview is a `vega device run-cmd` on your paired PC, sent through the bridge's allowlisted /vega endpoint (no shell on the PC, output capped, timeout enforced). Pair once, then browse /var, /data and the rest with the remote.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.fyaisa.files.main, or from apps/fileexplorer: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Pairs with ElevSH like every FYAISA app; approve it in FYAISA → ElevSH or with `fyaisa approve <code>`.
Themed like the hub: 8 presets plus per-setting customisation (colours, button style, animated background), persisted on the TV.
The ElevSH address box opens pre-filled with 192.168. — just punch in the last octets of your computer's IP.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Google Snake
apps.summary: Google's snake arcade game in a TV app. Needs internet, no account.
apps.description: Google's snake_arcade doodle game from google.com in a Vega WebView: Google's board, art, speeds and trophies. The remote's arrows and OK go straight to the page, Back quits, Home exits. The game streams from Google, so the stick needs internet; no sign-in.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.snake.main, or from apps/snake: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: No pairing needed — it never talks to your PC or the network.
1.1.5: lockfile aligned with the Vega SDK.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: DOOM (Shareware)
apps.summary: id Software's DOOM Episode One, compiled to WebAssembly, running fully offline on your Fire TV.
apps.description: The original DOOM engine, built from doomgeneric with emscripten, rendered to a canvas inside a Vega WebView with id's shareware episode embedded in the package. The D-pad walks and turns, OK fires and selects, Back opens doors and switches, Home exits. Nothing is fetched after install: engine, game data and loader all ship in the app. Sound effects play; music does not, and config or saves reset on exit.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: No prebuilt .vpkg is published in v2.0.0. Build from source with the Vega SDK: fyaisa install app.doom.main, or from apps/doom: npm install && npm run build:release && vega device install-app --dir . -b Release.

notes: Runs offline: the engine, the shareware episode data and the loader are inside the app.
Sound effects play, music does not. Config and saves do not survive leaving the app.
1.1.1: invalid manifest services removed and remote input handling fixed.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
